bio_md:
# 北乡侯 · 主要事迹

北乡侯刘懿是济北惠王之子。延光四年三月，[[e-han-an|安帝]]南巡崩于叶，阎皇后与兄阎显及宦官江京等定策，秘不发丧，还宫后立刘懿为帝——这是东汉又一次由后宫与外戚合谋的拥立。

刘懿在位约二百日即薨，史籍甚至未给他一个像样的本纪：他的存在，主要见于安帝纪之末与顺帝纪之首的夹缝。其治皆出阎氏，阎显兄弟与江京等权倾朝野，而帝本人无任何事迹可言。

十月，北乡侯薨。阎氏秘不发丧，欲更立他王，中黄门孙程等十九名宦官先发制人，斩江京，迎废太子济阴王[[e-han-shun|刘保]]即位，是为顺帝；阎后迁离宫，阎氏遂败。北乡侯不过二百日的「帝位」，成了阎氏与宦官两大势力对决的舞台布景，也是东汉最后一次「名分存疑」的准帝即位。

> 参考：点校本《后汉书》卷006《孝顺帝纪》、《安帝纪》、《皇后纪》、《宦者传》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Yi, Marquis of Beixiang, was a son of the king of Jibei. In the third month of the fourth Yanguang year,

died at Ye on his southern tour; Empress Yan, her brother Yan Xian, and the eunuch Jiang Jing settled the succession in secret, concealed the death, and raised Liu Yi to the throne upon their return to the palace — yet another enthronement engineered by the harem and the consorts.

He reigned about two hundred days before dying, and the histories did not even give him a proper benji: his existence is recorded mainly in the gap between the end of An's annals and the beginning of Shun's. All government issued from the Yan house; Yan Xian and his brothers with Jiang Jing dominated the court, while the emperor himself has no deeds whatever to his name.

In the tenth month the Marquis of Beixiang died. The Yans concealed the death, intending to raise another king; but the palace eunuch Sun Cheng and eighteen others struck first, slew Jiang Jing, and enthroned the deposed heir, the prince of Jiyin

, as Emperor Shun; Empress Yan was moved out of the palace and the Yan clan fell. The marquis's two hundred days of "reign" were the stage scenery for the showdown between the Yan faction and the eunuchs — and the last quasi-emperor enthronement of doubtful standing in Eastern Han.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Hou Hanshu*, ch. 6 (Benji of Emperor Shun), ch. 5 (Emperor An), the Annals of the Empresses, and the biography of the Eunuchs; Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
